about: Synthetic route scene, no plant data: integer metres on a made-up grid. Three ways from SMN_05 to PLN_02: A (north, straight, two-way, 20 m), C (straight, ONE-WAY stored toward SMN_05, 16.47 m) and B (south, two cubic hops, two-way: 16 m of chord, 21.6 m of arc). B chord < C < A < B arc, so a router that ignores direction, a router that weighs chords and a router that does neither each answer differently. LM941-LM942 is an island no route reaches. BIN_901 is a point on no segment. Segments are stored rows as RDS keeps them: one row per direction a robot may drive, handles in the row's own direction. One row is listed before its twin on purpose (PLN_02>LM921 before LM921>PLN_02), so a first-row-wins rule is visible.
